findings.text: ACC2 says Range.from_header and ContentRange.from_header validate their own values, but this task adds no test for that (for example a ContentRange with stop >= length, or a Range with begin >= end); they may be covered elsewhere.
ACC3 required no production change, because ETagSet.from_header already discards invalid items. The new test only locks in that existing behavior, and the declared etag.py is untouched.

summary: I found no blocking problems. ACC1 and ACC2 are implemented and tested. ACC3 was already true in the repo before this change. The only change to existing tests is added imports, so none was weakened.
